eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Intelligent Engineering, Quantum Computing & Innovation Management (IQIM 2027) provides a multidisciplinary forum for researchers, academics, and industry professionals to present advances in intelligent engineering, quantum computing, artificial intelligence, smart systems, and innovation management. The conference aims to foster collaboration between academia and industry, promoting innovative technologies and management strategies that drive digital transformation, sustainability, and future technological development.
